text:
Maya: quick sync — thinking about how the console surfaces WHY an automatic fallback happened. do we show raw trigger events by default or an aggregated reason?
Kevin: aggregated reason as primary view. raw events are noisy for most users. drilldown for SREs. :thumbsup:
Sophie: legal + security asked for an immutable list of events for audits. suggestion: default summary + an "expanded events" tab with raw timeline + event IDs.
Sam: +1. also need metrics exposed: fallback_rate, post_fallback_latency, routed_request_count. ops needs to know traffic impact without digging logs.
Oliver: for private deploys customers will want retention control (KMS/HSM + retention window). don't leak PII in event samples.
Maya: UI idea: a right-hand flyout when you click a policy -> top 3 contributing signals, percent of requests affected, and a small histogram of triggers over time. then a secondary panel for raw events.
Kevin: API note — we should provide /policies/{id}/events?start=&end=&limit=. make sure each event includes route_version and model_variant fields. that helps correlate rollouts.
Sophie: retention defaults: hosted = 1y, enterprise configurable up to 7y behind contract. we need to document export for compliance (CSV/NDJSON).
Sam: telemetry: add tags for `trigger_type` (latency/error/kv-cache-miss/quota) and `severity`. also capture a sample request id and upstream error if present.
Maya: UX question: do we display raw error messages inline? risk of leaking stack traces. maybe show sanitized message + a "show full" toggle for admins.
Oliver: +1 sanitize. also record a sha256 hash of the full message for forensic lookup without exposing it.
Maya: mock sketch: 
```
Policy Audit Flyout
- Summary: fallback_rate 3.2% (1h)
- Top signals: latency (55%), model_error (30%), quota (15%)
- Impact: 1.2k reqs rerouted
- Expand -> timeline of events (click event -> JSON sample)
```
Kevin: implementation checklist: events table in PG (or ES for query speed), event schema (ts, policy_id, trigger_type, route_version, severity, sample_req_id, sanitized_message, message_hash). API + RBAC on events.
Sophie: we need retention policy UI in Console settings + per-policy override. add audit export button in flyout.
Sam: prod telemetry must include a sampled KV cache snapshot id when cache_miss triggered (helps debug cold-start fallbacks).
Maya: CX concern: product teams want an "explainability" blurb users can read: e.g., "We routed to a smaller model due to latency spikes". should be human-friendly.
Kevin: also consider a pedagogical event for operators when fallback first occurs: send a Slack/ops alert with top 3 signals and link to flyout.
deploy-bot: deploy v2.8.1 to staging completed (canary 5%) :rocket:
qa-bot: smoke tests for fallback paths passed on staging. noted 0.8% fallback_rate during load test.
Maya: open questions / action items: 1) Kevin to spec events API and schema, 2) Sophie to draft retention & export UX, 3) Maya to mock flyout + copy for explainability, 4) Sam to add telemetry tags and sampling plan.
Kevin: I'll push an API PR with schema by EOD tomorrow.
Sophie: will post UX mock by Thursday.
Sam: I'll add metrics + sampling to the follow-up ticket.
Maya: thanks all — will link tickets and drop a short demo in next sync. :raised_hands:
